description_snippet:
Job Summary
We are looking for a Junior Product Manager - Decision Intelligence to help build a next-generation Collections Intelligence Platform from 0 to 1.
The platform will act as an intelligence layer for collections, helping collection managers, business teams, Credit Risk, Finance and senior leadership make data-driven decisions to improve collection efficiency and recovery outcomes.
The platform will combine multiple data sources, analytics, business rules and predictive/AI-ML models to answer critical collections questions such as:



Who should be contacted
When should they be contacted
Which channel should be used
What collection strategy or treatment should be applied
Which agent should handle the customer
When should a case be escalated
What is the most effective action to maximise recovery

This is a hands-on product role that will work closely with Collections, Credit, Risk, Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, Operations and external technology partners to translate complex collections requirements into scalable product solutions.
The platform will initially support a single lending product and will subsequently scale across multiple lending products.
Job Details

Job Level: Junior
Department: Product / BIU
Location: Bengaluru
Employment Type: Full Time
Experience Required: 2-4 Years
Job Type: Onsite
Reports To: Senior Product Manager

What You'll Work On

Build the Decision Intelligence Platform from 0 1

Work closely with the Product Manager to build the collections intelligence platform from concept to launch.
Deeply understand collections processes, challenges and decision-making frameworks.
Translate business and collections requirements into clear product requirements.
Identify opportunities where data, analytics, rules and models can improve collections outcomes.
Contribute to defining product workflows, decision journeys and system requirements.
Help build a scalable platform that can eventually support multiple lending products.
